Not for RQS scoring or veto adjudication — use ad-account-auditor; not for the ROI ratio math — use roi-calculator; not for cross-channel rollups — use performance-analyzer. 付费广告复盘/ROAS回看/投放效果归因
skills.name: Paid Measurement Loop · 付费广告复盘
